edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff the settlement amount to be mutually agreed in writing by the Parties (the “Settlement Amount”) within 10 business days after this Agreement is executed by both Parties. The Settlement Amount shall be paid in accordance with payment instructions agreed by the Parties in writing.
